question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the email link to set a new one.

question: How can I change my email address?
answer: Go to Account Settings, choose Profile, and update your email. You will need to verify the new address.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Account Settings, scroll to the bottom, and click Delete Account. This cannot be undone.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and mobile money.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Contact support within 14 days of purchase with your order number and we will process your refund.

question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
answer: Yes. Go to Billing and click Cancel Subscription. You keep access until the end of the billing period.

question: How do I update my billing information?
answer: Go to Billing, click Payment Method, and enter your new card or payment details.

question: Where can I download my invoices?
answer: Invoices are in the Billing section under Invoice History. Click any invoice to download it as a PDF.

question: Is my personal data secure?
answer: Yes. We encrypt data in transit and at rest and never sell your information to third parties.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: In Security Settings, turn on Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code with an authenticator app.

question: Why is the app running slowly?
answer: Try clearing your cache, updating to the latest version, and checking your internet connection.

question: Does the app work offline?
answer: Some features work offline, but syncing your data requires an internet connection.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Use the Help button in the app or email support@example.com. We reply within 24 hours.

question: Can I use the service on multiple devices?
answer: Yes. You can sign in on up to three devices at the same time.

question: How do I change the app language?
answer: Open Settings, choose Language, and select your preferred language from the list.
